title: TOPS bounded source/operation proof (Phase A)
scope: Host-only exact full-runtime append/getters and separately compiled exact-source cleanup semantics. No array validator/candidate or successful external execution.
source_pin: OpenZeppelin/openzeppelin-contracts@56a3de2cea907c9a500d32e70c275f68393b7ba6: eight exact dependencies; contracts/v1/token.sol exact captured source, independent maintainer pin unresolved
findings: Root31 mapping(address=>LPInfo[]) has three uint256 words; root 32 is available LP credit.
Cleanup uses wrapping sums and performs no mutation when expiredAmount wraps to zero.
Exact struct-array push requires old length < 2^64; invalid auto-getter index yields empty REVERT.
Constructor and transfer require external calls; existing bounded VM stops as HarnessFailure before them.
Root32 also has separate constructor/liquidity writers; no global always-coupled invariant is claimed.
